title: What We Do: Data Platforms and AI
description: Data platforms, integration, quality and governance on Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, and the AI built on top of them.
lead: We design, build and run modern data platforms: the pipelines, lakehouses and governance your reports and AI depend on. We work on Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, and once your data is in good shape, we build the AI on top.
summary: Five services: data platforms on Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, data integration, data quality and governance, AI-ready data and AI use cases, and managed data operations.

sections.heading: What does a modern data platform look like?
sections.answer: Five layers, from the systems you already use to data that’s ready for reporting and AI. Every service on this page builds or looks after one or more of them.

sections.heading: Questions about what we do
sections.answer: Short answers to what people usually ask about our services.

title: How We Work: Review, Design, Build, Run
description: How a DataKeel AI engagement runs, from Review to Design, Build and Run, and why you own all the code and documentation.
lead: Every engagement follows four steps: Review, Design, Build and Run, and you know what you get at each one. You own all the code and documentation, and we can hand the platform over to your team whenever you want.
summary: Four steps (Review, Design, Build, Run), client ownership of all code and documentation, and two ways to work together: a project or ongoing Run support.

sections.heading: What happens at each step?
sections.answer: Four steps, starting with a short fixed-price review so you know where you stand. Each step ends with something you can see and keep.

items.title: Review
items.text: We look at your data and systems and give you a written plan.
items.detail: What you get: a written plan with a data readiness score, your top 3 data risks, AI use cases for the next 90 days and a phased roadmap with costs.

items.title: Design
items.text: We agree on the platform, the sources and what success looks like.
items.detail: What you get: a platform design we agree on together, covering the architecture, the sources in scope and how we’ll measure success.

items.title: Build
items.text: We build in short steps, testing every change before it reaches production.
items.detail: What you get: a working platform, delivered in steps you can see and try, with every pipeline tested and every table documented.

items.title: Run
items.text: We keep the platform healthy and help your team get value from it.
items.detail: What you get: a monitored platform that keeps improving, and help for your team to use it. Or a full handover, if you’d rather run it yourself.

sections.heading: Who owns the platform?
sections.answer: You do. You own all the code and documentation, and we can hand the platform over to your team whenever you want.

items.title: Your code and documentation
items.text: Everything we build belongs to you, so you’re never locked in.

items.title: Your environment
items.text: The platform runs in your own cloud or on your own servers, so your data stays where you want it.

items.title: Handover when you want it
items.text: If your team wants to run the platform, we hand it over with the documentation they need.

sections.heading: How can we work together?
sections.answer: In two ways: a project to design and build your platform, or ongoing Run support after launch. You can choose either one, or start with a project and add Run support later.

items.title: A project
items.text: We design and build your platform, or one part of it, with an agreed scope. It starts with a Readiness Review.

items.title: Ongoing Run support
items.text: After launch, we operate, monitor and improve the platform for you, and help your team get value from it.

sections.heading: Questions about how we work
sections.answer: Short answers to what people usually ask before they start.

title: The DataKeel Standard for Data Quality
description: The quality checklist behind every DataKeel AI platform: tested pipelines, documented tables, data quality checks and no lock-in.
lead: This is the checklist every platform we build meets: every pipeline tested and monitored, every table documented, data quality checks before data reaches AI, and releases through automated pipelines. Your data stays in your own environment, and you own everything we build.
summary: The engineering practices behind every DataKeel AI platform: tested and monitored pipelines, documented tables, quality checks before AI, automated releases, client ownership, data location and security.

sections.heading: What does every platform we build include?
sections.answer: Five practices, on every project, whatever its size. Each one is there for a business reason, not for its own sake.

items.title: Every pipeline tested and monitored
items.text: Why it matters to you: problems are caught before they reach your reports, not in a meeting.

items.title: Every table documented
items.text: Why it matters to you: anyone on your team can find the right data and know what it means.

items.title: Data quality checks before data reaches AI
items.text: Why it matters to you: reports and AI tools work from data you can trust, so their answers are ones you can act on.

items.title: Changes released through automated pipelines across separate environments
items.text: Why it matters to you: every change is tested in development and test before it reaches production, so your live reports don’t break.

items.title: You own all the code and documentation
items.text: Why it matters to you: no lock-in. You can run the platform yourself or change partners at any time.

sections.heading: Your data stays where you want it
sections.answer: We build the platform inside your own environment, whether that’s your cloud (Azure, Microsoft Fabric or Databricks) or your own servers, on platforms such as Cloudera. You own everything we build.

sections.heading: How do you keep our data safe?
sections.answer: With the same four practices on every project. They protect your data and make every change to the platform traceable.

items.title: Access by role
items.text: People see only the data their role needs.

items.title: An audit trail of changes
items.text: Every change to the platform is recorded, so you can see who changed what, and when.

items.title: Secrets kept in a vault
items.text: Passwords and keys live in a vault such as Azure Key Vault, never in code.

items.title: Version-controlled, tested releases
items.text: Every change is stored in version control and tested before it’s released.

sections.heading: Where can I see the Standard in practice?
sections.answer: In our case studies. The labor cost platform on Microsoft Fabric releases every change through automated pipelines across development, test and production, and the hospital network lakehouse was built with access controls from day one.

title: About DataKeel AI
description: Why DataKeel AI exists: data is the backbone of AI. Our mission, our values of quality, clarity and ownership, and how we approach the work.
lead: We believe data is the backbone of AI, so we build the data platform first and the AI on top. Our work is guided by three values: quality, clarity and ownership.
summary: DataKeel AI's mission (data as the backbone of AI), its values of quality, clarity and ownership, its approach, and where it works.

sections.heading: Why does DataKeel AI exist?
sections.answer: Because AI is only as good as the data under it. Our mission is to build the data backbone your AI runs on: clean, governed data that every report and AI tool can trust.

sections.heading: What do we value?
sections.answer: Three things: quality, clarity and ownership. They shape how we build, how we talk and what you keep at the end.

items.title: Quality
items.text: We test, monitor and document everything we build, because your decisions depend on it.

items.title: Clarity
items.text: Plain language, clear plans and no surprises. You always know what we’re doing and why.

items.title: Ownership
items.text: You own all the code and documentation, and we build so that your own team could run the platform.

sections.heading: How do we approach the work?
sections.answer: Data first, then AI. We start with a short review of your data, build the platform in small tested steps, and keep it healthy after launch.

items.title: We ask before we sell
items.text: Every engagement starts with a Readiness Review, so we both know if we’re the right fit.

items.title: Data before AI
items.text: We get your data clean and documented before we build AI on top of it.

items.title: Built to hand over
items.text: Every platform is tested and documented, so you’re never tied to us.

sections.heading: Where do we work?
sections.answer: We focus on the US and UK, and we also work with companies in the Gulf, Singapore and Australia, remotely with your team.
